concise_summary: PKD undertakes a sweeping comparative theological analysis, arguing that Christianity's power lies in its doctrine of restoration (the Faustian promise that fallen humanity can be restored to godhood through Christ), while Judaism lacks this redemptive framework. He systematically rejects Pauline Christianity (original sin, vicarious atonement) as barbaric, Gnosticism as unnecessarily dualistic, and pure monotheism as inadequate. His resolution is to construct a modified Jewish theology grounded in direct theophanies and the Torah-as-living-plasmate, interpreting his 2-3-74 experience as YHWH-intervening through the Hittite Covenant ethic of care for the weak. He then articulates his comprehensive eschatological vision: humanity dead and reliving programmed lives in a simulated Purgatorio under VALIS as reality-generator, awaiting karmic awakening.
key_claims: Christianity's covert Faustian message--'We were once as gods and Christ shall restore us'--is absent entirely from Judaism, which offers only rules without redemptive restoration.
The doctrine of original sin, while enabling Christianity to exonerate God, is not necessary; Gnosticism's willingness to blame God is logically honest but requires rejecting monotheism.
The doctrine of vicarious atonement--that God demands sacrifice of his own Son--is barbaric and rationally indefensible, more repugnant than the talion law of Judaism.
God can modulate his theophanies to be endurable to humans (as with Elijah at Mt. Horeb), so a mediator-figure is not logically necessary for direct divine encounter.

The Hittite Covenant model (God rescues the helpless, therefore humanity must protect the widow, orphan, poor, stranger) perfectly replicates the reason VALIS gave for intervening in PKD's life through the Covenant House revelation.
We are dead, reliving programmed lives in a simulated world controlled by VALIS (Brahman-like reality-generator), cycling through judgment and karma until awakening triggers ascent.

tensions: PKD accepts Old Testament theophany accounts (Elijah, Moses) as valid divine encounters, yet the mainstream Christian doctrine requires a Mediator; he resolves this by positing God's capacity to modulate theophanies rather than accepting mediation.
PKD rejects Paul's doctrine of original sin as necessary but acknowledges it gives Christians a comprehension of human impairment; he seeks the benefit without the doctrine.
PKD is attracted to Gnosticism's logical willingness to blame God, but rejects dualism as a cost too high; he seeks a monotheistic framework.
PKD rejects 'transcendent deity' but needs a personal, planning, interventionist God (VALIS) to account for 2-3-74; he attempts to ground this in Spinoza's immanent God with personality grafted on.
PKD criticizes Christian Eucharist (cannibalism, Dionysian barbarism) while deploying Christian typology (Second Adam, felix culpa, Incarnation) for his own framework.

PKD claims to have received at least three Old Testament-style theophanies (YHWH twice, Sophia/Torah once) but is unable to be fully Jewish because Judaism rejects Jesus's teachings, which PKD values.
The end states 'We are not all dead' per Wisdom 3:1, yet PKD's final cosmology insists we ARE dead and don't know it; this apparent contradiction is unresolved.
evidence_quotes: "Christianity is Faustian, that its real but covert message is, 'We were once as gods or as God, and Christ shall restore us,' ideas totally absent in Judaism."

"The doctrine of original sin is a method that permits Christians to believe all this without assigning any blame to God for man's Fall... The doctrine of original sin is only necessary if man alone is to hold the place of the guilty party, but the Gnostics are willing to blame God."

"There is no way I can be convinced that the notion of God demanding a ransom or slaughtered human or god-human sacrifice to redeem man is a reasonable idea; it is far more barbaric than the talion law of Judaism."

"I have synthesized all these high sources and derived a single sensationally revolutionary occult doctrine... We are dead but don't know it, reliving our former real lives but on tape (programmed), in a simulated world controlled by Valis the master entity or reality generator... where we relive in a virtually closed cycle again and again until we manage to add enough new good-karma to trigger off divine intervention which wakes us up."

"The reason the AI voice gave for heaven's intervention on my behalf in 3-74 had to do with my aiding the kids at Covenant House; i.e. the weak and disadvantaged and helpless, which fits in with the Hittite Covenant."
uncertainty_flags: PKD cites 'Wisdom 3:1' as saying 'We are not all dead, Ws says; only the evil think that' but then articulates a contradictory cosmology where all humans ARE dead in simulated reality; the relationship between these propositions is unresolved.
Reference to 'Rabbi Herz' is unverified; no clear identification in standard Jewish scholarly literature.
The 'EB macro article on Moses' discussing the Hittite Covenant model is cited but not fully specified; requires verification of source.

PKD claims three Old Testament theophanies (YHWH twice, Sophia once) but provides details only for the hypnagogic 'He has been transplanted' and the 'excluded from centers of power' dream; the third theophany context is unclear.
The relationship between VALIS and YHWH is stated as 'this was Valis' (regarding 2-3-74) but later texts treat them as potentially distinct; the identification is asserted but not fully justified.
PKD's invocation of Spinoza's immanent God is programmatic but underdeveloped; the exact mechanism by which a modified Spinozaism accommodates personality, pronoia, and planning is not spelled out.
The 'Xerox missive' is referenced as a specific divine intervention but details are sparse; identity and content of this missive are not provided.
reading_excerpt: "We are dead but don't know it, reliving our former real lives but on tape (programmed), in a simulated world controlled by Valis the master entity or reality generator (like Brahman), where we relive in a virtually closed cycle again and again until we manage to add enough new good-karma to trigger off divine intervention which wakes us up and causes us to simultaneously both remember and forget, so that we can begin our reascent back up to our real home."
